description.narrative:
The proposed project¿ overall objective is to increase the participation of young women and men in the economic development of the country through 3 objectives:

§ Objective 1: Increasing youth participation in the economic sector by providing ICT-based skills and facilitating their exposure to the labour market for employment opportunities.

§ Objective 2: Fostering young women and men¿s role in developing their local communities.

§ Objective 3: Promote youth¿s work-related mental health and psychosocial wellbeing and aid the institutionalisation of a peer-to-peer support network.
